scenes.headline: The optimiser comes back
scenes.sub: Kosmo-GFM, VGGT plus BA, Budget3D and a Solv3R demo
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fennick. This week, three of four posts say the same thing: a network makes the guess, and an optimiser finishes it.

steps.say: Kosmo-GFM predicts cameras, depth, moving points and matches from a set of images.

steps.caption: PoseEngine: star graphs, then bundle adjustment
steps.say: Then PoseEngine groups images into stars of twenty-six, runs the network on each, and finishes with bundle adjustment.

scenes.title: Why a small pose error costs so much

legend: Every frame sees every wall point
Bundle adjustment: poses and points together

steps.say: A three-sixty walk down a room. Each frame casts a ray to every wall point, and the true rays meet on the walls.
Turn each heading by two degrees. All its rays turn too, and the points land eighteen point three centimetres off.
steps.term: Triangulation: intersecting rays from known poses

steps.say: Bundle adjustment solves headings and points together, from the same rays. The error drops to under half a centimetre.

scenes.title: 34 scenes, cumulative hours
scenes.say: On thirty-four scenes PoseEngine has the best pose accuracy, in fourteen hours, a fifth of GLUEMAP's time.

steps.caption: Mip-NeRF 360: 26.69 dB against 28.40
steps.say: But splats trained from its poses trail GLUEMAP's by one point seven decibels on Mip-NeRF three-sixty.
Its training data, KosmoWorld, renders real scans as pinhole, fisheye and panorama frames, each with depth.
The paper reconstructs rooms from fisheye and panoramic frames.

steps.caption: Released: pinhole cameras only
steps.say: The release supports pinhole cameras only, and the pose engine isn't in it.

scenes.title: Desk clip, point error, cm
scenes.say: I ran the released models on a desk clip with motion capture. Give the camera-conditioned model exact poses and points land twenty-two centimetres off. Add five degrees of noise and it's thirty-nine. It trusts what it's given.

steps.say: Budget3D lets one image-to-3D model run on fewer tokens.

steps.caption: Coarse tokens where the latent is flat
steps.say: Empty space merges into coarse tokens first. At fifty percent, sampling is one point seven nine times faster.
Idol's eight thousand one hundred ninety-two tokens sit on a three-level octree.
The first layout is built from pure noise, with no dense warm-up.
At step five it is rebuilt from the model's own clean estimate.
Then it stays fixed. Speed is measured. Quality isn't published yet.
Solv3R's demo streams two hundred eighty-eight frames of a desk.

steps.caption: This splat panel is not in the public code
steps.say: The splat training in the clip is a panel the public demo doesn't contain. Its COLMAP export is.
